/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2023_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'telephone|phone|registrant', txt, re.I):
        print(i, t.get('page_no'), txt[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"

texts=data['texts']
for i in range(10, 18):
    t=texts[i]
    print('IDX', i, 'PAGE', t.get('page_no'), 'TEXT:', repr(t.get('text','')))
